reader.requirement: The quotation marks that open and close a nonnumeric literal (the only 1985 delimiter; a doubled quotation mark inside stands for one) are not part of its value, wherever the literal appears (VALUE, MOVE, ALL literal, STRING, relation, a literal continued across lines).

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry.Check refuses at 85 the apostrophe delimiter (ApostropheQuotationSymbol2002), the X".." form (HexAlphanumericLiteral2002), N/B literals and the zero-length literal (ZeroLengthLiteral2014)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/Dialect/ConstructRegistry in CobolLiteral.cs: Decode strips the delimiters identically at every edition; the only edition consult is the format gate in LiteralScreen
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 only the quotation mark delimits a nonnumeric literal (apostrophe, X, N, B and zero-length forms are refused with COBOL0900); the value of a quote-delimited literal is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f03_03 covers MOVE and DISPLAY of short literals; not exercised are VALUE, ALL literal, a literal continued across lines, STRING operands, reference-modified receivers and the refused later delimiters

probes.printed: ["A"  ] / [ABABABA] / [ABC..XYZABC456789END      ] / QUOTES IN CONTINUED 00 / [QR  ] / [A"B      ] PTR 04 / EQ / PADDED EQ / ["A"AB]
probes.expected: VALUE """A""" is "A" (3 chars); ALL "AB" fills without quotes; the continuation line's opening quote is no part of the value; STRING of "A" """" "B" gives A"B with pointer 4; reference-modified receiver gets AB

probes.printed: COBOL0900 for X"41" (requires COBOL-2002), 'HI' (apostrophe requires COBOL-2002), "" (zero-length requires COBOL-2014)
probes.expected: 1985 delimits a nonnumeric literal only by the quotation mark and allows 1 to 160 characters: each refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.1.3 GR2  (4.2.2.2.1.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: Decode returns the body between the delimiters with doubled delimiters collapsed, one code path for every edition; the reference-format stage joins a continued literal before the lexer, and the probe shows the continuation quote is not in the value. The 85-specific part is the refusal of later-edition delimiters, which LiteralScreen does.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-187/rl1.cob (runs/rl1-001, --std 85, generated with exact columns): a literal open to column 72 then continued keeps the 39 trailing spaces and drops the continuation's opening quote ([ABC<39 sp>DEF]); a continuation beginning with a doubled quote (-  """X") gives the value "X; VALUE """""" is two quotes; 88 VALUE "A""B" THRU "B""A" range tests by the one-quote values (A"C and B"@ both IN); ALPHABET literals and CURRENCY SIGN IS "#" (PIC #(3)9 -> ' #12'); INSPECT REPLACING ALL "," BY """" gives A"B; a literal holding ,;. and *> kept verbatim. All values exclude the delimiters. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.1.3 GR2  (4.2.2.2.1.3 General Rules)  the text is in GR2'. The reader's lit2 covers the refusal of the later delimiters at 85.
